questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由三角函数公式:}\\&I=\int_{0}^{\pi}\frac{\sin^{2}3t}{1-2a\cos t+a^{2}}dt=\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{\pi}\frac{1-\cos 6t}{1-2a\cos t+a^{2}}dt=\frac{1}{4}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}\frac{1-\cos 6t}{1-2a\cos t+a^{2}}dt\\&=\frac{1}{4}\int_{0}^{2\pi}\frac{1-\cos 6t}{1-2a\cos t+a^{2}}dt\\&\quad\text{令}z=e^{t},\text{则}dt=\frac{dz}{iz},\cos t=\frac{z^{2}+1}{2z},\text{于是:}\\&\int_{0}^{2\pi}\frac{1}{1-2a\cos t+a^{2}}dt=\oint_{z=1}^{2\pi}\frac{1}{1-2a\frac{z^{2}+1}{2z}+a^{2}}\frac{dz}{iz}=i\frac{2\pi}{i}\operatorname{Re}s[\frac{1}{(z-a)(1-az)},a]=\frac{2\pi}{1-a^{2}}\\&\int_{0}^{2\pi}\frac{\sin 6t}{1-2a\cos t+a^{2}}dt=\int_{0}^{2\pi}\frac{\sin 6t}{1-2a\cos t+a^{2}}dt+i\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}\frac{\sin 6t}{1-2a\cos t+a^{2}}dt\\&=\int_{0}^{2\pi}\frac{e^{i6t}}{1-2a\cos t+a^{2}}dt=\frac{1}{i}\oint_{\pi}^{\pi}\frac{z^{6}}{1-2a\frac{z^{2}+1}{2z}+a^{2}}\frac{dz}{iz}\\&=\frac{1}{i}2\pi\operatorname{Re}s[\frac{z^{6}}{(z-a)(1-az)},a]=\frac{2\pi a^{6}}{1-a^{2}}\\&\quad\text{于是}\\&I=\frac{1}{4}(\frac{2\pi}{1-a^{2}}-\frac{2\pi a^{6}}{1-a^{2}})=\frac{\pi(1-a^{6})}{2(1-a^{2})}=\frac{\pi}{2}(1+a^{2}+a^{4}).\end{aligned}
